statement: Pinned Linux hid-wiimote's evdev IR open path requests only basic IR mode (hid-wiimote-modules.c:719-724). Its extended/full mode selection cases and report handlers are unreachable from that evdev path. If extended-mode reports were reached, the parsed size nibble would be discarded; if full-mode reports were reached, the parser would omit full-only bytes 3-8 and expose coordinates alone. This is a host evdev-path limitation, not a raw HID or retail-device limitation.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Linux consumer: hid-wiimote-modules.c:550-605 (input parser and size nibble at 596-597), 687-697 (extended/full selection cases), 719-731 (evdev always selects basic); hid-wiimote-core.c:1507-1515,1556-1585 (mode handlers). No claim that evdev selects extended/full.
